accepted.rationale: Audited ESM P256 ECDSA/ECDH plus the synchronous generic Poseidon permutation and constant generator.

accepted.name: @noble/ed25519
accepted.rationale: Small ESM RFC 8032 Ed25519 implementation selected by PR #111.

accepted.name: @noble/hashes
accepted.rationale: Audited synchronous ESM SHA-256, SHA-512, Keccak, HMAC, and HKDF implementation.

accepted.name: bs58
accepted.rationale: ESM Base58 encoding for Solana address derivation.

rejected.name: poseidon-lite
rejected.reason: PR #111 used it, but version 0.3.0 is unaudited and CommonJS. The audited @noble/curves Poseidon primitive remains subject to frozen Rust vector parity in P04.
